name: Sikadur®-51
tagline: EPOXY FLEXIBLE RESIN FOR SEALING JOINTS
summary: Sikadur®-51 is a 2- component 100% solids epoxy joint sealant of a putty like consistency based on flexible epoxy resins. After mixing it cures to form a tough but resilient sealant and patching compound.
metaDescription: Sikadur®-51 is a 2- component 100% solids epoxy joint sealant of a putty like consistency based on flexible epoxy resins. After mixing it cures to form a tough but resilient sealant and patching compound.
attributes: It can be used as a safety sealant (non-pick)
Permanently flexible, does not stiffen over time.
Excellent adhesive properties to many materials.
Complies with ACI-302.1R (4.10-Materials for sealing together).
Can be used on slopes up to 15%.
Durable and resists heavy traffic and forklift tyres.
Can be applied to damp substrates with use of a primer, Sikadur® -52.
usage: Filling of horizontal control and construction joints with little or no movement.
For heavy duty concrete floors and is often used in conjunction with Sikafloor epoxy systems.
Filling of cracks with little or no movement.

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Between + 5 ° C and + 35 ° C. Condition the material at a temperature between 18 ° C and 24 ° C before use.

items.label: Viscosity
items.text:
Component A: | 5.800 cps
Component B: | 7.900 cps
Mixed A + B : | 7.000 cps

items.label: Tensile adhesion strength
items.text:
Steel: 2.5 MPa approx. (sandblasted)
Concrete: 2.0 MPa approx. (sandblasted)

items.label: Curing rate
items.text:
For Pedestrian traffic | 1-2 days
For vehicle loading | 2-6 days
(both dependant on temperature)

items.label: SUBSTRATE QUALITY
items.text: All surfaces must be clean, dry and free from any loosely adhering particles or surface contaminants such as dirt, oil, dust, grease, etc.

items.label: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
items.text: The substrate should be clean and firm. All dust, grout, grease, curing agents, adhesion inhibiting impregnations, waxes and any other contaminants should be removed. The concrete must be clean and prepared, removing the surface grout and giving it an open pore texture by abrasive treatment or equivalent mechanical means.

items.label: MIXING
items.text: For best results premix each component. Pour Component A and Component B into a clean container in equal parts by volume. Mix properly with low speed drill (400 to 600 rpm) for at least 3 minutes until color is uniform. Mix only the amount to be applied within the life of the product.

items.label: CLEANING OF EQUIPMENT
items.text: Uncured material may be cleaned from application tools etc. by using Sika Colma Cleaner (flammable solvent). Cured material can only be removed mechanically.
